label: pds_Data_Set_PDS3
definition: A PDS data product from the PDS 3 data model.

label: spase:DisplayData
definition: A graphical representation of data wherein the underlying numeric values are not (readily) accessible for analysis.

label: spase:Catalog
definition: A tabular listing of events or observational notes, especially those that have utility in aiding a user in locating data.

label: spase:NumericalData
definition: Data stored as numerical values in one or more specified formats.

label: PDS data product
definition: A product from the PDS data system

label: pds_Collection_with_Type_Data
definition: A PDS data product from the PDS 4 data model.

label: discovery interface
definition: An interface that 1) presents users with discovery criteria and may 2) lead to an access interface.

label: field campaign
definition: A campaign that is coordinated among one or more individuals and/or one or more organizations.

label: investigation
definition: A set of experiments and/or observations.

label: observing campaign
definition: A campaign that 1) uses primarily but not exclusively existing facilities and 2) after and possibly during which other investigations are carried out using the same facilities.

label: event
definition: Something observable that happened at a given time and place

label: campaign
definition: A systematic set of activities undertaken to meet a particular science objective.

label: assay
definition: An assay is an investigative (analytic) procedure for qualitatively assessing or quantitatively measuring the presence, amount, or functional activity of a target entity.

label: data product
definition: A product containing science data from some investigation.

label: hardware
definition: The mechanical, magnetic, electronic, and electrical equipment necessary for conducting an activity.

label: author
definition: An originator or creator of a work

label: space agency
definition: A government agency engaged in activities related to outer space and space exploration.

label: instrument host
definition: The physical object upon or within which an instrument is mounted.

label: organism
definition: The quality of a living subject that indicates the taxonomical grouping of the subject. This grouping can be at any level in a hierachy of organism classification, or a collection of levels, and can be using scientific language or colloquial language.

label: product
definition: Any offered product or service.

label: study
definition: A data product from the GeneLab repository

label: factor
definition: The role played by an entity as part of a scientific investigation such that levels of the measurement or observation of the entity are thought to bear upon the hypotheses being investigated.

label: access interface
definition: A software interface that 1) presents users with selection criteria and 2) presents products or services that meet the criteria the user then selects.

label: research investigation
definition: An investigation that 1) uses existing facilities and 2) is under the direction of a single individual.

label: specimen
definition: A part of a feature, taken to demonstrate or to determine the character of the whole.

label: information product
definition: A product that describes some entity.

label: experiment Apparatus
definition: Hardware used in conducting an experiment.

label: deployment
definition: The realisation of an application, or execution of a plan, idea, model, design, specification, standard, algorithm, or policy.

label: software
definition: An information content entity that 1) contains a set of machine-readable instructions (most often in the form of a computer program) that 2) conform to a given syntax (sometimes referred to as a language) that 3) is interpretable by a given processor and that 4) directs a computer's processor to perform specific operations.

label: funder
definition: A role in which the bearer delivers financial support to enable some activity.

label: instrument operating mode
definition: An identified configuration for an instrument.

label: mission
definition: Coordinated tasks and operations undertaken to meet a set of specific objectives, within clearly delineated time and location constraints.

label: laboratoryProcedure
definition: Any procedure that involves testing or manipulating a sample or subject in a laboratory setting

label: person
definition: An agent that is a human being.

label: NASAMission
definition: A mission led or funded by NASA

label: instrument
definition: An instrument is a physical object that can be used to collect data.

label: experiment
definition: A plan for a coordinated set of actions and observations designed to generate data, with the ultimate goal of discovery or hypothesis testing.

label: metadata product
definition: An information product that contains structured metadata.

label: feature
definition: A material entity that has characteristics that can be qualified or quantified through observation or experiment.

label: facility
definition: A construction, permanent or temporary, on land, in air, space or water, where scientific research or measurements can be undertaken.

label: phenomenon
definition: A fact or situation that is observed to exist.

label: observation
definition: Act of carrying out an procedure to estimate or calculate a value of a property of a feature.

label: photoGallery
definition: A graphical user interface that provides access to photographs/images.

label: organization
definition: An entity that can bear roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules.

label: program
definition: A broad framework of goals to be achieved.

label: document
definition: A written or printed paper that bears the original, official, or legal form of something and can be used to furnish decisive evidence or information.

label: data element
definition: A data element is any characteristic that can help in understanding data content. That is, a data element is any parameter or variable that is useful, or critical, when identifying or describing the content of a data object.

label: firmware
definition: Software that provides the low-level control for a device's specific hardware.
